name: szilard_engine

numpy.reason: numeric quadrature of the single-particle work integral and a genuine Monte Carlo ensemble over random which-side measurement outcomes.

qutip.reason: single-molecule positional degree of freedom in a box has no operator/Hilbert-space content in the standard Szilard derivation; qutip would be decorative here.

C3_zero_information_zero_work.note: free expansion with no piston coupled extracts exactly zero work across all N trials -- this is the information-licenses-work control.

C4_never_exceeds_landauer_bound.note: the idealized 100%-efficient Szilard engine saturates but must never exceed the Landauer erasure cost per bit; exceeding it would violate the second law over the combined engine+memory-reset cycle.

C5_grid_convergence.note: bounds how much the coarse grid's numerical error could be masking; fine grid is the reported value.
